allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:6000/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; Write-Output "IPv4 OK: $\($r.StatusCode\) $\($r.Content\)" } catch { Write-Output "IPv4 FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:6000/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; Write-Output "localhost OK: $\($r.StatusCode\) $\($r.Content\)" } catch { Write-Output "localhost FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 6000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table LocalAddress, LocalPort, State -AutoSize)
